About Guru Computer Education Institute

Your Trusted Computer Training Institute in Bilha

Established in 2015, Guru Computer Education Institute has been focused on quality computer training for students, professionals and learners in Bilha, Bilaspur. हमारा उद्देश्य सिर्फ software सिखाना नहीं, बल्कि students को confidently computer use करना और practical work करना सिखाना है।

अगर आप Bilha या Bilaspur के आसपास Basic Computer, Tally GST, DCA, PGDCA, CCC, Typing, Photoshop, Canva या AI ChatGPT course ढूंढ रहे हैं, तो institute practical learning, regular practice और career guidance पर focus करता है।
